scores.evidence: All three objectives are can-do statements, and each has 3 or more graded items with objectiveId (o1: q0, q1, e1, e2; o2: q2, q3, e3, e4; o3: q4, q5, e5, e6). q0 is now tagged o1. o1 is 'create / 設計できる', but every o1 item asks the learner to pick a ready-made check, and no practice step has the learner design one.

hook-lead sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences ('「完了しました。正しく動作します」…翌日、別の入力でエラーが出ました。何があれば防げたでしょうか。'), with no trivia, followed by the predict item q0 (o1). The distractors are now tempting: c '依頼文に「テストも書いて」と一言だけ足す', and d is reading the report line by line.

The prerequisites match the real titles of cc-01 to cc-03, and s1-why recalls the 第1回 agentic loop. 'ターン' is now defined before use in s2-goal ('Claudeが応答を1回終えるまでを、ターン（turn）と呼びます'). s5-defs now comes before s5-styles. Definitions blocks and glossary entries match word for word.

measure.mjs: 'prose 1998 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 19.2 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)', and lint --strict shows 0 warnings. Every segment has a table, prompt, diagram or quiz. 4-4 is still the heaviest section, with 10 blocks (fresh-context review, the over-engineering trap, sorting, the /review alias). 4-2 holds two ideas (evidence and /goal) plus 3 new terms (証拠, ターン, /goal).

In 4-3 (example), s3-steps gives 5 labelled subgoals, each with its reason ('関数がないと、テストは読み込みで止まります'; '失敗を先に見ると、テストが新しいコードを試しているとわかります') and a correct expect ('fail 4', then 'pass 4・fail 0', then a diff of only postal.mjs). The two prompts and the test code follow. The practice repeats the flow with fewer explanations, but it is still fully prompted rather than independent.

Every content section ends with an inline quiz at apply, analyze or evaluate level (q1 header vs design image, q2 which report has evidence, q3 an edited expected value, q4 the 5,000円 boundary, q5 an unclear finding), with feedback on every wrong option. q1's key ('直した画面と届いた画像を見比べ、ずれを挙げて直して') no longer echoes the wording of s1-table.

All 7 misconceptions in the brief appear as distractors, each with a corrective feedback of 2 sentences or fewer. The e4 filler option is gone: d is now 'ビルドが通ったので、念のためテストも実行させてから受け入れる', and its feedback says the ignored type error remains. q5 option a's feedback now names the real error ('迷う指摘まで直すと、過剰設計につながります').

s4-sort is a 5-node process diagram whose labels use the text's own terms (正しさ, 要件, 必須, 任意). Its caption states the takeaway ('必須にするのは、正しさと要件に関わる指摘だけ'), and its alt text is descriptive. s1-table and p-model-sort are comparisons with captions, and there are no decorative images.

The practice is an authentic task in a throwaway folder (p-setup). It has 8 steps with expects the learner can now reproduce (empty function committed first, 'テストと空の関数ができ、テストはすべて失敗します'), plus hint and troubleshoot fields, a 7-item checklist and a model answer (p-model-code, p-model-sort). Hints go only 1–2 levels deep, and no step transfers o1 (designing a check for one's own task).

summary-points (5 points) comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question ('手元のタスクに、どの確認を渡せますか。') and names 第5回. There are 7 retrieval flashcards and an askTutor block with 3 suggestions.

The 4 audit-confirmed overclaims are fixed as the audit proposed (s1-why '「結果を確かめる」を、Claude自身が回せます', s2-goal '満たすか無理と判定されるまで…進展がないときや…でも止まります', s2-goal-prompt '20ターンに達するまで', s4-trap 'たいてい'). The red/green flow now matches the verified Node 22 behaviour, the screenshot check cites cc-chrome, and the version is pinned in the subtitle. Two places are below 4: card-fresh drops the hedge ('甘くなるからです'), and p-prompt-write does not say to export the empty function.

The lesson uses です・ます throughout, is warm and non-pressuring, lint finds no banned phrases, and terms match the glossary (検証, 証拠, テストファースト, サブエージェント, 過剰設計). There is minor repetition in s2-goal ('判定し、満たすか無理と判定される'); wording belongs to the ja-editor.

The lesson is jp only and complete. The diagram has a caption and alt text. Both links have descriptive text ('[Chromeとの連携](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/chrome)', '[日本語の公式ドキュメント](…/ja/best-practices)'), and no text is baked into images.

niceToHave: o1 is at create level but is only assessed by selection. Add a p-steps item after p-explain: id 'p-design', title '⑨ 手元のタスク1つに、渡す確認を考える', expect '確認の種類と、依頼文に足す一言を1行で書けます。'. Add the checklist item p-c8 '自分のタスクに合う確認と、依頼文に足す一言を書いた'.
check-quiz e1 and e2 carry bloom 'create' but are selection items. Set them to 'evaluate', which matches what they test.

p-prompt-write: as 4-3's ex-write says, a missing export leaves the test file stuck at load. Replace '{{テストの道具}}で、テストだけを書いてください。実装のファイルには、中身が空の `isLeapYear` だけを置いてください。' with '{{テストの道具}}で、テストを書いてください。実装のファイルには、中身が空の `isLeapYear` をexportして置くだけにしてください。'
summary-cards card-fresh back: restore the hedge used in s4-lead: '自分の仕事を自分で採点すると、甘くなりがちだからです。サブエージェントや `/code-review` に頼みます。'
p-steps p-evidence: name the commands the learner runs. Add hint '`git diff --stat` で差分を見てから、`node --test` を実行します。'
p-steps p-commit: add hint 'Claudeに「テストと空の関数をコミットして」と頼んでもかまいません。' so learners who keep the session open know how to commit.

4-4 is still the heaviest section. Consider dropping s4-names from the body, since the glossary entry '/code-review' already carries the /review alias, and moving the Japanese-docs link to summary-next.
check-quiz e2: the key b is the longest option, which is a length cue. Shorten it to '「`npm test` の失敗が0件になる。テストのファイルは変更しない。または20ターンで止める」'.
summary: review-scope.mjs exited 1 (29 of 57 blocks changed, 51%), so this is a full review. All 7 round-1 must-fix items are gone: the empty exported function is committed with the tests in both the example and the practice, ターン is defined, the screenshot check names Chrome access, and q5 and e4 are reworked. The audit's 4 overclaims are fixed as proposed. The 4-3 worked example and the sorting diagram are the strongest parts. The most useful next step is optional: have the learner design one check for their own task, so that o1's create level is actually practised.
